headline: EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism Impacts Brazilian Steel Exports
summary: Brazilian steel exporters are facing price pressures as the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) begins implementation in 2027, requiring carbon emission data for trade negotiations.
why: The CBAM is a climate policy tool designed to prevent 'carbon leakage' by imposing costs on imports based on their carbon footprint, affecting non-EU manufacturers.

impacts.name: Steel Industry
impacts.why: Increased compliance costs and potential tariffs may reduce the competitiveness of Brazilian steel in Europe.
